mapper.select: SELECT RECEIPT_STATUS, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM RECEPTIONIST_REGISTER WHERE RECEIPT_STATUS IN ('접수완료', '호출중', '진료중', '보류') GROUP BY RECEIPT_STATUS

SELECT r.MEDICAL_NUMBER , r.SPACE_NUMBER
, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM RECEPTIONIST_REGISTER r2 WHERE r2.SPACE_NUMBER = r.SPACE_NUMBER AND r2.RECEIPT_STATUS = '접수완료' AND ( r2.RECEIPT_DATE < r.RECEIPT_DATE OR (r2.RECEIPT_DATE = r.RECEIPT_DATE AND r2.MEDICAL_NUMBER < r.MEDICAL_NUMBER) ) ) +1 AS WAITING_TURN_NUMBER
, r.RECEIPT_STATUS AS STANDBY_STATE
, ( ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM RECEPTIONIST_REGISTER r2 WHERE r2.SPACE_NUMBER = r.SPACE_NUMBER AND r2.RECEIPT_STATUS = '접수완료' AND ( r2.RECEIPT_DATE < r.RECEIPT_DATE OR (r2.RECEIPT_DATE = r.RECEIPT_DATE AND r2.MEDICAL_NUMBER < r.MEDICAL_NUMBER) ) ) * 10 ) + ( CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM RECEPTIONIST_REGISTER r3 WHERE r3.SPACE_NUMBER = r.SPACE_NUMBER AND r3.RECEIPT_STATUS = '호출중' ) THEN 10 ELSE 0 END ) AS EXPECTED_WAITING_TIME
, m.MEMBER_NAME AS MEMBER_NAME
, SUBSTR(m.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER, 1, 6) AS BIRTH_DATE
, CASE WHEN SUBSTR(m.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER, 7, 1) IN ('1', '2') THEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM SYSDATE) - (1900 + TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(m.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER, 1, 2))) WHEN SUBSTR(m.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER, 7, 1) IN ('3', '4') THEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM SYSDATE) - (2000 + TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(m.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER, 1, 2))) ELSE 0 END AS AGE
, CASE WHEN MOD(TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(m.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER, 7, 1)), 2) = 1 THEN '남' ELSE '여' END AS GENDER
, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM APPOINTMENT a WHERE a.MEMBER_NUMBER = r.MEMBER_NUMBER AND a.RESERVATION_STATUS = '예약확정' AND TRUNC(a.RESERVATION_START_DATE) = TRUNC(r.RECEIPT_DATE) ) THEN '예약' ELSE '당일' END AS RECEIPT_TYPE
, r.RECEIPT_DATE
FROM RECEPTIONIST_REGISTER r JOIN MEMBER m ON r.MEMBER_NUMBER = m.MEMBER_NUMBER WHERE r.RECEIPT_STATUS = '접수완료'
AND r.SPACE_NUMBER = #{spaceNumber}
ORDER BY r.RECEIPT_DATE ASC, r.MEDICAL_NUMBER ASC

SELECT r.MEDICAL_NUMBER , r.SPACE_NUMBER , r.RECEIPT_STATUS AS STANDBY_STATE , m.MEMBER_NAME
, CASE WHEN SUBSTR(m.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER, 7, 1) IN ('1', '2') THEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM SYSDATE) - (1900 + TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(m.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER, 1, 2))) WHEN SUBSTR(m.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER, 7, 1) IN ('3', '4') THEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM SYSDATE) - (2000 + TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(m.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER, 1, 2))) ELSE 0 END AS AGE
, CASE WHEN MOD(TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(m.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER, 7, 1)), 2) = 1 THEN '남' ELSE '여' END AS GENDER
FROM RECEPTIONIST_REGISTER r JOIN MEMBER m ON r.MEMBER_NUMBER = m.MEMBER_NUMBER WHERE r.RECEIPT_STATUS IN ('호출중', '진료중')
AND r.SPACE_NUMBER = #{spaceNumber}

SELECT r.MEDICAL_NUMBER , r.SPACE_NUMBER , r.HOLD_REASON , m.MEMBER_NAME
, CASE WHEN SUBSTR(m.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER, 7, 1) IN ('1', '2') THEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM SYSDATE) - (1900 + TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(m.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER, 1, 2))) WHEN SUBSTR(m.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER, 7, 1) IN ('3', '4') THEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM SYSDATE) - (2000 + TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(m.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER, 1, 2))) ELSE 0 END AS AGE
, CASE WHEN MOD(TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(m.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER, 7, 1)), 2) = 1 THEN '남' ELSE '여' END AS GENDER
FROM RECEPTIONIST_REGISTER r JOIN MEMBER m ON r.MEMBER_NUMBER = m.MEMBER_NUMBER WHERE r.RECEIPT_STATUS = '보류'

UPDATE RECEPTIONIST_REGISTER SET RECEIPT_STATUS = '호출중' WHERE MEDICAL_NUMBER = (
SELECT MEDICAL_NUMBER FROM ( SELECT MEDICAL_NUMBER FROM RECEPTIONIST_REGISTER WHERE SPACE_NUMBER = #{spaceNumber} AND RECEIPT_STATUS = '접수완료' ORDER BY RECEIPT_DATE ASC, MEDICAL_NUMBER ASC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1 )
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM RECEPTIONIST_REGISTER WHERE SPACE_NUMBER = #{spaceNumber} AND RECEIPT_STATUS IN ('호출중', '진료중') )
